channel.title: AI Builder's Field Guide — Recently Added
channel.description: A daily-curated wiki of the tools, models, and patterns that AI power-users and builders actually reach for.

item.title: Paperclip
item.description: Paperclip is an open-source "Office Harness" that provides a runtime environment for AI agents to manage work across spreadsheets, documents, and other office applications. — It offers a unified platform for agents to interact with common office tools, enabling complex automated workflows that would otherwise require custom integrations for each application.

item.title: Univer
item.description: Univer is an open-source office suite harness that allows AI agents to interact with spreadsheets, documents, slides, and PDFs within a single runtime. — It provides a standardized and integrated environment for AI agents to perform complex tasks involving various office document formats, enhancing agent capabilities for productivity.

item.title: Hermes Agent
item.description: A self-improving agent that learns and writes its own skills from experience for autonomous task execution and interaction. — This framework focuses on continuous learning and self-improvement, enabling agents to evolve their capabilities over time, unlike more static agent frameworks.

item.title: Superpowers
item.description: A framework for defining and using agentic skills, designed to integrate a software development methodology into AI agents. — It provides a structured approach for agents to acquire and apply skills, contrasting with general-purpose agent frameworks that often require custom skill implementation.

item.title: Tencent BrowserSkill
item.description: Tencent BrowserSkill is a CLI and browser extension for AI agents to automate logged-in web interactions. — This enables AI agents to automate complex, authenticated workflows within a browser, unlike generic web scraping APIs like Firecrawl or Context.dev. It handles logged-in sessions and background execution, which is critical for tasks requiring persistent state or direct interaction with web applications.

item.title: GPT-6 Astra
item.description: OpenAI's most capable model, available via API and ChatGPT. — Pick this over GPT-5.6 Sol for complex reasoning and multi-step tasks, where it provides better performance.

item.title: OpenHands
item.description: OpenHands is an open-source framework for AI-driven development that enables large language models to assist with coding tasks and project management. — It allows developers to integrate autonomous AI agents directly into their software development workflows, offering a more active and comprehensive approach compared to traditional AI coding assistants.

item.title: Taste-Skill
item.description: Taste-Skill is a GitHub project providing a skill registry and prompt set to enhance the aesthetic quality and originality of AI-generated design and frontend code. — This tool helps address the common problem of generic AI outputs in design by offering structured guidance, allowing AI agents to produce more visually appealing results beyond basic design system prompts.
